events.title: 브라이언 매클레어 scores a hat-trick in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 4–1 home win over 더비 카운티 to bring his league tally for the season to 19 goals.
맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 3–3 with 리버풀 at Anfield after being 3–1 down, but remain eleven points behind the Merseysiders in the League table.

리버풀 move closer to an unprecedented second double by beating 노팅엄 포리스트 2–1 in the FA Cup semi-final at Hillsborough . 윔블던 end 루턴 타운's cup double hopes with a 2–1 win at White Hart Lane to reach the final for the first time. In the league, 17-year-old Alan Shearer becomes the youngest hat-trick scorer in the First Division in 사우샘프턴's 4–2 home win over 아스널.
헐 시티 sack manager Brian Horton . 리버풀 and 노팅엄 포리스트 do battle for the third time in twelve days, and just as four days ago, the Merseysiders come out on top, as they win 5–0.

토키 유나이티드 winger Lee Sharpe , who turns 17 next month, agrees to sign for 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the end of the season in a £30,000 deal. 하트 오브 미들로디언 striker John Robertson agrees to join 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for a club record £750,000 at the end of the season. The Football Association suspends Chris Kamara for the rest of the season.
리버풀's 1–0 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 confirms the Reds as League champions. 왓퍼드 are relegated thanks to 찰턴 애슬레틱's 2–0 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
Holders 아스널 are beaten 3–2 by 루턴 타운 in a dramatic League Cup final at Wembley. It is Luton's first major trophy.

옥스퍼드 유나이티드 are relegated after defeat against 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 포츠머스 are favourites for the last automatic relegation place, trailing 웨스트햄 유나이티드 by four points with two matches left. The promotion issues in the Second Division have yet to be confirmed, with just four points separating the top five clubs – 밀월, 애스턴 빌라, 브래드퍼드 시티, 미들즈브러 and 블랙번 로버스. 더비 카운티 goalkeeper 피터 실턴, 38, sets a new Football League appearance record when he makes his 825th league appearance since his debut 21 years ago in his side's 1–1 draw at 왓퍼드.
